input.source_content: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants and some other organisms use sunlight to synthesize foods with the help of chlorophyll. Carbon dioxide and water react in the presence of light energy and chlorophyll inside chloroplasts to produce glucose and oxygen.
A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom. Its chemical formula is H2O.
The First World War lasted from 1914 to 1918. Its causes were Militarism, Alliances, Imperialism, and Nationalism.
Metaphor is a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable.
The cell is the basic structural unit of all living organisms.
